annotations.title: Send a quote request to Zain

description: Emails the user's name, email address and project details to Zain so he can reply with a fixed-price quote, usually within 24 hours. The request goes only to Zain and is used only to reply to it.

email.description: Email address Zain should reply to.

project.description: What they need built or fixed, in a few sentences.

service.description: Optional. Closest service, for example "Shopify development".

timeline.description: Optional. When they need it, for example "within 4 weeks".

name: request_quote
title: Send a quote request to Zain
